data.one_liner: Prompt users to upgrade when a newer version of the app is available in the store.
data.what_it_does: Checks public store pages or custom appcasts for newer app versions and prompts the user with an alert dialog or a card widget containing update buttons, ignore options, and release notes.
use_when: You need to nag users to update their app more quickly than usual
You want to enforce a minimum app version using store description metadata
avoid_when: Your app relies on native Android In-App Updates API or Huawei AppGallery API
Your app uses legacy Flutter material imports without standalone material_ui/cupertino_ui and you cannot upgrade or migrate yet
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and appcast support for others
Built-in minimum version enforcement via store descriptions
Customizable alert dialogs, cards, themes, and localized messages
weaknesses: Relies on scraping public Google Play Store pages for Android instead of native APIs
Requires standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages in version 14+
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and wrapping your home widget or using UpgradeAlert/UpgradeCard. Version 14 requires migrating to standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages.
